# accrue S10 P5 (Q-S10-11 (a), Q-S10-12 (a)): the stored rows of the zk ring
# check for test/wgsl/zk.lang. A bLSAG ring of 2 keys (p0, p1), poll 0,
# choice 1, sig words c1, s1, s2, I. The generator (accrue-lang-work
# s10/r15-gen.sh, outside the repo) chains the wasm results: link 1 (s1, c1,
# p0) gives c2, link 2 (s2, c2, p1) gives c1 again. The third link is link 2
# with s2 + 1 (bad: it does not give c1). zkStep with a count of 3 or 1 gives
# none. zkDig gives the D word of the zkStep rows.
